nodes.title: Restore WorkArea.tsx
nodes.summary: src/components/WorkArea.tsx is 0 bytes, which breaks the typecheck and build and causes all 70 App.test.tsx failures. Rewrite it from the original with the props App.tsx passes (components, selectedId, onSelect, snapEnabled, armedShapeId, onPlaceArmed, onCancelArmed). It should render the centre point and shapes, handle selection, show the cursor preview and tie in the snapping helpers, then re-run the App.test.tsx suite.

nodes.title: Fix anchor matching in snapping.ts
nodes.summary: findBestAxisMatch compares every shape anchor with every candidate, so a shape's end can snap to a target's centre, while the tests expect like-for-like matching (start to start, centre to centre, end to end). Decide which behaviour is intended; the recommendation is to change the code to compare matching anchors only, which resolves the 6 snapping.test.ts failures.

nodes.title: Correct circleSnap test expectation
nodes.summary: circleSnap.test.ts:76 expects nearestSnapAngle(338) to be 315, but 338 is closer to 360 (0), so the code is right. Change the test input to about 336 or change the expected value to 0.

nodes.title: Correct hoverSide test expectation
nodes.summary: hoverSide.test.ts:136 expects 'right' at point (60,100) inside box (0,0,100,100), but the bottom edge is at distance 0 and the right edge at 40, so 'bottom' is correct. Change the test to expect bottom.

nodes.title: Triage dependency vulnerabilities
nodes.summary: npm audit reports 3 vulnerabilities (2 critical, 1 moderate), including tinypool prototype pollution via vitest@3.2.7. The fix is vitest 5.x, a breaking change. These are dev-only dependencies and the CI audit step is non-blocking, but the roadmap asked for them to be triaged.

nodes.title: Clean up config, docs and Node version
nodes.summary: Delete deploy-manager.json or make it match the README, which says Deploy-Manager uses the Dockerfile with no separate manifest. Delete the unused ShapeSelect.tsx or wire it in. Update the README structure section and the click-to-place description to the current arm-then-place flow. Confirm the build on Node 20.19.0, as pinned in the Dockerfile and .nvmrc, before deploying.
